# Does your indoor pickleball facility pencil out?

> Pickleball facility pro forma: enter courts, rates, utilization, memberships and costs and see monthly P&L, revenue per court-hour, break-even utilization, 24-month cash curve and payback. Free, runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
